This morning, a group of resilient protesters gathered outside of New York Times executive editor Joe Kahn’s residence to hold him responsible for the war crimes he’s committed not only in the genocide of Palestinians, but the Iraq war. Through Joe’s career he has been a staunch propagandist for empire peddling Zionist and imperial talking points, reporting false information, and most notably responsible for the widely debunked report “Screams Without Words” (which accused Hamas fighters of sexual violence with no evidence). 

His ties to Israel and pro-Israel lobbyists go all the way back to his billionaire father who served on the board of the Zionist media watchdog group CAMERA in the 1990’s. The legacy of Zionism in his family seems to continue as his son (who has been reported to attend many protests as a counter protester) made an appearance this morning once again defending his father and Zionism all together. 

Gaza has run out of time. They are in the final stages of a holocaust with fatalities due to famine growing every minute. The @nytimes is complicit in manufacturing consent for this genocide, along with false reporting and unethical journalism through adjusted coverage and inaccurate headlines. 

We must not give a minute of peace to Zionists, especially ones who are directly complicit in the genocide of Palestinians. 

To learn more about NYT complicity visit newyorkwarcrimes.com/dossier 

Photos by @framed.unrest 

Other notable appearances this morning include: 
-Uncover private security 
-NYU security 
-New School security 
-NYPD 
-Owner of Boris & Horton (dog cafe)
